positions.locationName: Fort Collins, Colorado, United States · Remote

positions.title: Web & UX Consultant
positions.description: Provided UX, design and development services to an wide array of clients. Industries include wine, photography, branding, architecture, and dining.

positions.title: UX Designer
positions.description:
Lead designer on app and web for Pro Referral (Redbeacon 2.0). Worked hand-in-hand with product and research teams to shape business goals and validate design decisions. Ran in-house workshops on useful tools and the design process.

Created a living style guide for both designers and engineers. Contributed to the codebase directly to fine-tune interactions and CSS architecture.

positions.title: User Experience Design Intern
positions.description: UX and visual design lead for a lean team within Macy's.com. We developed a market expansion strategy and prototype mobile app pitched to the executive team in 10 weeks. Parts of our idea were implemented in the Macy's app and stores. Also developed UX specs, high-fi mocks and code for the Macy’s.com Brand Guidelines.

positions.title: Web Team Lead
positions.description: Re-architected and maintained 4 large-scale ecommerce sites with over 21k SKU's. Implemented version control and modern development practices. Hired, trained and managed a 3-person design and development team.

positions.title: Brand Designer & Webmaster
positions.description: Executed a complete visual rebrand for a Canadian Cloud Services Accelerator, including web, print and social media design.

positions.title: Lead UX Designer & Consultant
positions.description: Designed and implemented UI of MVP for a GIS Mapping startup. Created corporate site and UI toolkit for engineering team.

positions.title: Project Management Intern
positions.description: Responsible for coordinating all stages of web product release for a multinational company. I also produced graphic design work for promotional campaigns and internal use.
